programmes.title: La firme
programmes.description: A la fin de ses études de droit, Mitch McDeere, brillant élément, est sollicité par plusieurs grands cabinets d'avocats. Il fixe son choix sur Bendini, Lambert & Locke, qui lui offrent les conditions les plus avantageuses. En contrepartie, il devra, comme chaque membre du cabinet, fournir quelque quatre-vingts heures de travail hebdomadaire. Il ignore encore qu'il vient de vendre son âme au diable.

programmes.title: Inside Man
programmes.description: Een man heeft de perfecte bankoverval gepland. Vanuit zijn cel vertelt hij er ons alles over. De overvallers komen de bank binnen en alles verloopt prima totdat er mensen worden gegijzeld en de onderhandelingen van start gaan. De keiharde inspecteur Keith Miller krijgt heel wat kritiek over de manier waarop hij de zaak aanpakt en dan is er ook nog Madeleine White, een advocate met een heel aparte agenda ...

programmes.title: The 39 Steps
programmes.description: Richard Hanney has a rude awakening when a glamorous female spy falls into his bed - with a knife in her back. Having a bit of trouble explaining it all to Scotland Yard, he heads for the hills of Scotland to try to clear his name by locating the spy ring known as The 39 Steps.

programmes.title: The Lady Vanishes
programmes.description: On a train headed for England a group of travelers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris befriends elderly Miss Froy. When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveler and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

programmes.title: Malcolm X
programmes.description: Biographical epic about the influential and controversial black nationalist leader, from his early life and career to his eventual assassination.
